scripts.dev: npm run build -w apps/web && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build && scripts/with-secrets.sh sh -c 'wrangler d1 migrations apply trailblazer --remote && wrangler deploy'
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p apps/worker && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p packages/shared
scripts.db:migrate:remote: scripts/with-secrets.sh wrangler d1 migrations apply trailblazer --remote
scripts.db:status:remote: scripts/with-secrets.sh wrangler d1 migrations list trailblazer --remote
